fields.Name: IT09 - Scheduled Jobs Engine Lifecycle
fields.Description: Exercises the Scheduling engine's run lifecycle + distributed lease against the live DB, independent of what the job's driver does (the job points at a missing Record Process so the driver fails fast + deterministically — the engine contract runs identically on success or failure). SJ1: ExecuteScheduledJob persists a terminal MJ: Scheduled Job Run and increments the job's stats (RunCount, LastRunAt). SJ2: the distributed lock (LockToken/ExpectedCompletionAt) is released after the run so the job is immediately re-runnable, and a second execution bumps RunCount to 2. The bundle creates + tears down its own job/run fixtures.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A run persists a terminal Scheduled Job Run + increments stats; the lease is released and the job is immediately re-runnable.
